items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses the status and internal dynamics of 'Thad and Mel's band' based on the interviewer's prompts, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship with Thad himself.

ctx.x: most cases they are basically glorified rehearsal bands, and -- who on occasion play some engagements.
Well, that's kind of a commentary, too, of what I just heard, that Thad and Mel's band is breaking up. I don't know if you knew that.

Well, I don't know if it was ever really organized. So that's really being candid, because for several years it was a Monday night band in New York City. Every Monday night they met and played the music. And then in more recent times, they've gone to different parts of the world, and tried to -- I renamed them the Bed and Board Band, and only for the reason that they were accepting engagements just to have a band. That was their only purpose. And it's a very wonderful purpose except that I don't feel that it's…
